description: A hero banner (mj-hero) that holds content blocks over a background.

members.name: BackgroundColor
members.description: Gets or sets the background colour (background-color).

members.name: BackgroundHeight
members.description: Gets or sets the background height (background-height).

members.name: BackgroundPosition
members.description: Gets or sets the background position (background-position).

members.name: BackgroundUrl
members.description: Gets or sets the background image URL (background-url).

members.name: BackgroundWidth
members.description: Gets or sets the background width (background-width).

members.name: Blocks
members.description: Gets the blocks rendered inside the hero.

members.name: Height
members.description: Gets or sets the hero height, used in fixed-height mode (height).

members.name: Mode
members.description: Gets or sets the sizing mode, fluid-height or fixed-height (mode).

members.name: VerticalAlign
members.description: Gets or sets the vertical alignment of content (vertical-align).
